source.section: III.C.5 Entry Blanks (printed p19; PDF p26)
source.quote_free_summary: The organizer's entry blank must also carry a parent or guardian's consent signature for Juniors.

requirement: Competition OS does not produce entry blanks or capture a guardian signature for Juniors. Until Option A is built and approved, no under-18 competitor can be registered through Competition OS, so no Junior entry exists that would need that signature.
enforcement_point: Server: checkout route age gate (avoidance). The consent-signature requirement is not implemented.

tests.name: checks every member of a team and both halves of a couple; one minor refuses the whole draft

interpretation_notes: Avoided by OD-02 Option C, not implemented. The effective date is the edition month; an exact effective date is NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE. Which entries NDCA treats as Juniors (age bands) is part of the OD-03 audit item and is not decided here. NDCA VI.A.11, Registration - General (PDF p39) also makes a parent or guardian responsible for learning the rules for a registrant under 18; informational, not implemented.
